plates.room: a small cramped rented room in Manila at night, a thin mattress, an electric fan, a motorcycle helmet on a plastic chair, a window with city lights, lit by the cold glow of a phone.
plates.park: a wide city park in Manila before sunrise, a tall grey granite obelisk monument with a bronze statue group at its base in the distance, empty paved plaza, lamp posts still lit, palm trees, pink and blue dawn sky.
plates.field: a wide open grassy field beside Manila Bay in 1896 at cold dawn, low mist on the grass, old stone fortress walls far away on one side, a few bare trees, calm sea and pale gold sunrise sky.

full.squad: seen from behind, a straight row of eight men in blue-and-white striped cotton uniforms and straw hats standing at attention shoulder to shoulder, a second row of men in darker uniforms standing behind them, misty grassy field at cold dawn, pale gold sky, solemn mood, no faces visible.
full.rizal_back: seen from far behind, a slim man in a black suit and black bowler hat standing alone and upright on a misty grassy field, his back to the viewer, facing the sea and a pale gold sunrise, long shadow on the grass, quiet and solemn, face not visible.
full.phone_msg: extreme close-up of a brown hand holding a smartphone in a dark room, the screen showing one glowing chat bubble with a small red umbrella icon and a clock icon and nothing else.
full.marker: close-up of a flat bronze memorial plaque set in the grass of a park at dawn in Manila, Philippines, the plaque face smooth, plain and blank: no writing, no letters, no characters, half in soft tree shadow, a few fallen leaves on it, a pair of sneakers at the edge of frame. Single image, no panels, no border, no black bars, the picture fills the whole vertical frame.
full.soldiers: a column of 1896 colonial guards in blue-and-white striped uniforms and straw hats walking through morning mist, a drummer in front, and among them, seen from behind, a slim man in a black suit and black bowler hat walking calmly, old stone walls behind.
full.pulse: extreme close-up of two hands only: a hand in a dark military uniform sleeve gently holding the wrist of a man in a black suit sleeve with a white cuff, taking his pulse, misty dawn light, no faces.
full.hands: extreme close-up of two hands only: a woman's hand in a dark coat sleeve tightly holding a young man's brown hand with indigo tattoos on the forearm, misty dawn field blurred behind.
full.volley: a great cloud of white smoke drifting low over a misty field at sunrise, a flock of startled birds bursting up from bare trees into a pale gold sky, no people, solemn and quiet.
full.chest_empty: extreme close-up of the chest of a young man in a loose white collarless shirt, his brown hand clutching at his bare collarbone where a necklace should be, a snapped piece of cord between his fingers, no face in frame.
full.m_gone: a red umbrella lying open and abandoned on wet grass in a misty field at dawn, footprints in the dew leading away into the mist, no people.
full.stove: close-up of a small old brass alcohol burner stove on a wooden table in a dark prison cell, candle light, beside it a tightly folded sheet of yellowed paper seen from the outside, plain and blank: no writing, no letters, no characters. Single image, no panels, no border, no black bars, the picture fills the whole vertical frame.
full.tattoo: Close-up of a brown-skinned forearm held up in front of a misty field, white shirt sleeve rolled to the elbow, five small indigo geometric tattoos in a row on the forearm, none glowing. Only the arm is in frame, no face.
full.note: extreme close-up of a brown hand unfolding a small folded piece of paper, the paper blank: no writing, no letters, no characters, only a tiny drawing of a red umbrella in one corner, the thumb covering the middle, misty morning light. full.m_back: seen from behind and far away, a woman in a long dark coat walking away into thick morning mist on a grassy field, long black hair, one hand holding up a small glowing bronze medallion on a cord, golden light around it, face not visible.
